subject: science
topicName: Homeostasis: Keeping the Body in Balance
description: Students explain homeostasis as active regulation of internal conditions and identify measurable indicators such as temperature, glucose, blood pressure, water balance, and breathing rate.
learningObjectives: Define homeostasis as active regulation within a healthy range.
Identify common indicators of homeostasis in humans.
Explain why body systems must work together to maintain stable internal conditions.
